description_en: Queries the details of submitted asynchronous task executions
description_zh: 查询已提交异步任务执行明细
name: QueryAsyncTask

parameters.description_en:
Unique task ID

> The system automatically generates the TaskId by default. If subsequent tasks use the same TaskId, they belong to the same conversation group.
parameters.description_zh:
任务唯一ID

>TaskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的TaskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话。
>
